title: Fire to coolness
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y2 lesson 6 (Pupil PDF worksheet: fire to coolness)
intro: Lesson 6: Prophet Ibrahim (عليه السلام): trusting Allah and telling the truth. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Statues cannot help
points: People made statues and worshipped them
Ibrahim said they cannot hear or help

panels.title: The fire
points: The people threw Ibrahim into a fire
Allah made the fire cool and safe

box.title: Draw flames turning into cool water drops. Finish: 'Ibrahim trusted Allah, so ...'

keywords.def: close friend: Ibrahim is the close friend of Allah

questions.q: Why did Ibrahim say the statues were not worth worshipping?
questions.a: They cannot hear, see or help; only Allah can.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, draw flames turning to cool water drops and write: 'Ibrahim trusted Allah, so ...'
Extend: Allah calls Ibrahim His Khalil. What does that mean?
Stretch: give one time you need to tell the truth even if it is hard.
questions.a: For example: owning up after breaking something

questions.q: What did Allah do to the fire?
questions.a: A) Made it cool and safe. Allah protected Ibrahim because he trusted Him (21:69).

questions.q: Think again: why did Ibrahim tell the truth when it was hard?
questions.a: He trusted Allah and loved the truth.
